LayoutPanel.summary: Base class for all auto-layout panels (grid, stackpanel, tables, itemlistview and friends); it lays out children through a shared cell table.

props.classname: Class name string, "layoutpanel", used to identify the control type and look controls up by type.
props.itemMargin: Outer margin per child {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels, i.e. the gap between a cell and its child.
props.itemPadding: Inner padding per cell {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels, used to expand cells during layout and hit testing.
props.minItemWidth: Minimum child width in pixels; layout never makes a child narrower. Default 1.
props.maxItemWidth: Upper bound for child width in pixels, used as a reference limit when autoArrangeH distributes free space; 0 means unlimited.
props.minItemHeight: Minimum child height in pixels. Default 1.
props.maxItemHeight: Upper bound for child height in pixels, used as a reference limit when autoArrangeV distributes free space; 0 means unlimited.
props.autosize: When true, the panel resizes its own height to the layout result (Resize is called at the end of _LayoutChildren). Default false.
props.rows: Forced row count; together with columns it determines the grid split (only used in resizeItems mode). nil means derive automatically.
props.columns: Forced column count; nil means derive automatically (from ceil(sqrt(child count)) or back-computed from rows).
props.autoArrangeH: When true, leftover horizontal space in a line is shared among cells by the "level the shortest cells first" algorithm (source marks this FIXME rename).
props.autoArrangeV: When true, leftover vertical space is shared among lines by the same "level the shortest lines first" algorithm (source marks this FIXME rename).
props.grid: When true every row must hold the same number of columns (table layout); a source comment notes this is not implemented yet.
props.resizeItems: When true, _LayoutChildrenResizeItems is used and all children are stretched to fill the clientArea grid; when false, children are flowed at their own sizes.
props.centerItems: When true (and the cell is larger than the child), the child is centered inside its cell and leftover line space is distributed centered. Default true.
props.weightedResize: When true, space is distributed in proportion to each child's weight instead of equally; a missing weight counts as 1.
props.selectable: When true, children can be selected with the mouse. Default false.
props.multiSelect: When true, multi-selection is allowed (with the shift/ctrl keys). Default true.
props.selectedItems: Set of selected children, shaped like { [itemIdx] = true }.
props.OnSelectItem: Event table (list of listeners) fired when a child's selection state changes; callback receives (itemIdx, selected).
props.OnDrawItem: Placeholder callback for drawing a single child's background; the source marks it FIXME and the base class never calls it.
props.OnDblClickItem: Event table fired when a child is double-clicked; callback receives (itemIdx) (ImageListView passes items[itemIdx], itemIdx).
props._rows: Internal field: the row count actually computed during layout, written by _LayoutChildrenResizeItems (internal).
props._columns: Internal field: the column count actually computed during layout (internal).
props._cells: Internal field: layout rectangle table {x, y, w, h} per child, relative to clientArea, used for drawing and hit testing (internal).

LayoutPanel:New.desc: Constructs the panel; when selectable is true the first child is selected by default (selectedItems = {[1]=true}).

LayoutPanel:SetOrientation.desc: Sets the layout direction and calls inherited.UpdateClientArea to recompute the client area.

LayoutPanel:_JustCenterItemsH.desc: Splits the leftover horizontal space of cells [startCell,endCell] equally, shifting each cell right and widening it (internal).

LayoutPanel:_JustCenterItemsV.desc: Vertical variant: splits the leftover height equally among those cells, moving each down and increasing its height (internal).

LayoutPanel:_EnlargeToLineHeight.desc: Sets every cell in the line to the line height minus that cell's top and bottom padding (internal).

LayoutPanel:_AutoArrangeAbscissa.desc: Distributes the line's leftover horizontal space by levelling the shortest cells up to the next shortest size and shifts the x of following cells; with autoArrangeH off it falls back to centered distribution when centerItems is set (internal).

LayoutPanel:_AutoArrangeOrdinate.desc: With autoArrangeV on, distributes leftover vertical space among lines the same way and moves following lines down; otherwise vertically centers items within each line (internal).

LayoutPanel:GetMaxWeight.desc: Collects the maximum weight per row and per column (weight defaults to 1) plus the weight sums, for weightedResize.

LayoutPanel:_GetMaxChildConstraints.desc: Returns a child's constraint rectangle (x, y, w, h): the cell when it is already known during layout, otherwise an estimate from margin/itemPadding and the clientArea (internal).

LayoutPanel:GetMinimumExtents.desc: Returns the minimum extents (right, bottom); the current implementation simply returns x+width and y+height (an earlier experiment is commented out).

LayoutPanel:_LayoutChildrenResizeItems.desc: Layout in resizeItems mode: derives the grid from rows/columns or ceil(sqrt(child count)), sizes cells equally or by weight, calls child:_UpdateConstraints for each and stores the boxes in _cells (internal).

LayoutPanel:_LayoutChildren.desc: Default flow layout: accumulates child sizes and wraps automatically (or at columns), fills _cells/_lines/_cellPaddings, shares leftover space via centerItems/autoArrange, resizes itself when autosize is set, then updates child positions (internal).

LayoutPanel:UpdateLayout.desc: Layout entry point: calls RealignChildren, picks _LayoutChildrenResizeItems or _LayoutChildren by resizeItems, then calls RealignChildren again; returns early when there are no children (after zeroing one dimension when autosize is set).

LayoutPanel:DrawBackground.desc: Empty implementation, intended for subclasses to override and paint the panel background.

LayoutPanel:DrawItemBkGnd.desc: Empty implementation, intended for subclasses to override and paint the background of child number index.

LayoutPanel:DrawControl.desc: Draws the control body by calling self:DrawBackground(self).

LayoutPanel:DrawChildren.desc: Translates the coordinate system, calls DrawItemBkGnd for every child to paint backgrounds (debug mode also outlines _cells in red), then draws children in the clientArea through the 'Draw' channel.

LayoutPanel:DrawChildrenForList.desc: Same as DrawChildren, but children are drawn through the 'DrawForList' channel.

LayoutPanel:GetItemIndexAt.desc: Expands each cell by itemPadding and hit-tests it with InRect, returning the index of the matching child.
LayoutPanel:GetItemIndexAt.returns: matching index, or -1 when nothing matches

LayoutPanel:GetItemXY.desc: Returns the cell rectangle of child itemIdx.
LayoutPanel:GetItemXY.returns: x, y, w, h; nil when the index is invalid

LayoutPanel:MultiRectSelect.desc: Selects every child inside the convex hull of the two cells item1 and item2; append adds to the current selection, otherwise the set is replaced and OnSelectItem fires for removed and added items, then Invalidate is called (does not update _lastSelected).

params.append: whether to append to the current selection

LayoutPanel:ToggleItem.desc: Flips the selection state of one child, updates _lastSelected, fires OnSelectItem and calls Invalidate to repaint.

LayoutPanel:SelectItem.desc: Selects one child: append adds it, otherwise the whole selection set is replaced and OnSelectItem(false) fires for dropped items; then the listener for the selected item fires, _lastSelected is updated and Invalidate is called.

params.append: whether to append without clearing other selections

LayoutPanel:DeselectItem.desc: Clears one child's selection, fires OnSelectItem(false), updates _lastSelected and calls Invalidate.

LayoutPanel:SelectAll.desc: Calls SelectItem(i, append) for every child; note that append here is an undefined global variable (effectively nil).

LayoutPanel:DeselectAll.desc: Calls DeselectItem for every entry in selectedItems to clear the selection one by one.

LayoutPanel:MouseDown.desc: Forwards the event to children first; when selectable, the right button triggers DeselectAll while the left button dispatches to MultiRectSelect, ToggleItem or SelectItem depending on mods.shift/ctrl.

params.button: button number (3 is the right button)

LayoutPanel:MouseDblClick.desc: Forwards the event to children first, then fires OnDblClickItem(itemIdx) and returns self when a child is hit.

fileDesc: Implements the LayoutPanel base class for every auto-layout panel: lays out children with cell grids or flow algorithms and provides selection handling, hit testing and drawing hooks.
